name: Imouto ~doublesite~
source:
Main character is a healthy boy who attends college. Eventually he discovers that his sister and childhood friend have become ripe women. What will  he do for a week in love?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-october-2006-shuumatsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名身心健康的男大学生。他渐渐发现，自己的妹妹和青梅竹马已经成长为成熟的女性。这一周的恋爱生活中，他会做出什么选择？
